verdict.rationale: A live, versioned production REST API platform exists: api.service.hmrc.gov.uk returns a structured, header-based error contract. Making Tax Digital is an officially sanctioned channel where filing runs through compatible software, and a developer hub host exists. However, the API documentation itself was not readable, because the developer hub blocks every crawler except Googlebot. The evidence also routes registration flows (Corporation Tax, VAT, PAYE employer) only through online web services, not the API. Missing for 10: directly evidenced API reference documentation and auth/onboarding details, API coverage beyond Making Tax Digital filing (registration and account management), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving tax workflows end to end via the API.
